# schematize.org

> The open-source and technology-research lab behind schematize. We build tools in
> the open and share what we learn about engineering with and for AI agents.
> schematize.org is the single home for everything schematize — institutional,
> open-source and research.

## What this is
schematize.org is informational and institutional: it documents our open-source
projects, technology research and the company behind them. It is not a store.

## Open-source projects
- Applications page: https://schematize.org/en/apps/ (one page per app: /en/apps/schematize, market,
  overdev, deployer, optimizer, database, git, skills; /software redirects there).
- schematize — the hub CLI (Rust; Linux and FreeBSD x86_64): installs/versions engineering
  skills for Claude Code and runs overdev (continuous, unattended development).
  https://github.com/schematizeme/schematize-cli
- Ecosystem apps (each with a CLI and a desktop window, 20 interface languages):
  schematize-market (installer/updater; also installs Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor CLI),
  overdev, deployer, optimizer, database, git, skills. Linux/FreeBSD installer flags:
  --deployer, --optimizer, --database, --git, --skills (additive), --completo (full kit,
  includes overdev). The hub and the market always come with any install.
- Full-kit install (Linux): curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/schematizeme/schematize-cli/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --completo
  FreeBSD: fetch -o - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/schematizeme/schematize-cli/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --completo
  Installs to ~/.cargo/bin, no sudo, prebuilt binaries. The install.sh supports only Linux
  and FreeBSD; macOS binaries are in the releases (no automatic installer).
- Windows (x86_64; PowerShell 5.1/7, no admin): irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/schematizeme/schematize_windows_rs/main/install.ps1 | iex
  Full kit (also languages/tools via winget): & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/schematizeme/schematize_windows_rs/main/install.ps1))) -Completo
  Windows has schematize-market and overdev only (CLI + windows); the hub, optimizer, deployer,
  git, database and skills are Linux/FreeBSD only. overdev needs Git for Windows
  (winget install --id Git.Git -e). Manual download: https://github.com/schematizeme/schematize_windows_rs/releases/latest
- schematize skills — normative engineering playbooks (engineering, go, rust, web,
  seo, node, pentest) for Claude Code. https://github.com/schematizeme

## Research areas
- Reliable AI-agent engineering and orchestration
- Security of AI-assisted software delivery
- Standards and tooling that make agent output trustworthy

## Ecosystem

- schematize.educe.me — the academy

- github.com/schematizeme — source code
